g.text: Instagram: One Upload, Two Fan-Outs, Two Lifetimes
Feed and Stories share the same follow-graph and fan-out workers -- only the retention differs
The upload path and transcoding happen ONCE. Both fan-outs then read the SAME follow graph -- one lookup, two writes with different TTLs.
Building a second fan-out pipeline just for Stories would duplicate infrastructure that already exists to answer 'get this to my followers.'
